remarks: Bright and spacious this gorgeous house has the wow factor you've been looking for!  Dramatic entry with stone pillars and circular driveway. Located in the prime area of Westover on almost 4 aces of privacy. Sunken Living Room, Family Room with fireplace opens to the kitchen, plus an additional great room with fireplace.  Spectacular Chef's Dream Kitchen with 2 center islands with all the gourmet amenities, wine cooler, warming drawer, plus custom cabinetry, etc. etc.  Seven Bedrooms, 8.5 Baths - Main floor Primary Bedroom with walk-in closet and ensuite bathroom with jacuzzi tub, shower & double vanity. Each Bedroom has its own full bath! Laundry room on main level plus laundry in the Lower Level. 4 Car Garage, Generator and 2 Bedroom in-law apartment which includes a living room and fireplace plus sliders to a beautiful, private backyard.
